integrity: The proof exhaustively classifies ordinary dominating sets by bipartition occupancy. Crown distances make the selected deleted-matching pairs the only semipartner obstructions, so the allowable-partner graph is a complete graph minus a matching and has a perfect matching for every even order at least four. This gives the full polynomial and all stated corollaries.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs with n at least three.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from three through eight and is corroborative only.
The 2018 introducing article was available through institutional bibliographic metadata and abstract rather than full searchable text in the accessible route.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown-specific result may exist.
title: Semipaired domination polynomial of crown graphs
